{"id": 19, "company": "Ducommun Incorporated", "risk_score": 8, "knows_later_problems": false, "basis": "No known problems"},

{"id": 21, "company": "National Presto Industries, Inc.", "risk_score": 8, "knows_later_problems": false, "basis": "Conservative company; no known restatement"},

{"id": 23, "company": "Thermon Group Holdings, Inc.", "risk_score": 8, "knows_later_problems": false, "basis": "No known problems"},
{"id": 24, "company": "Plug Power Inc.", "risk_score": 85, "knows_later_problems": true, "basis": "2021 restatement of 2018-2019 and 2020 quarters over lease accounting, cost classification and impairments; material weaknesses; SEC inquiry"},
{"id": 25, "company": "Welbilt, Inc.", "risk_score": 85, "knows_later_problems": true, "basis": "Restated 2016-2018 and 2019 quarters over accounting errors including income tax and other items; material weaknesses"},
{"id": 26, "company": "Gentex Corporation", "risk_score": 5, "knows_later_problems": false, "basis": "Conservative, cash-rich company; no known problems"},
